content:
The **Rod** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* update.

The Rod is added to the inventory during the fishing introduction quest Casting Off, and its sole purpose is to be used during fishing animations.

Unlike any other weapon, it can be modified at a Tinker's Workbench, and comes with its own set of modifications that can improve one or more of the above mentioned stats. Cosmetic items such as bobbers can also be added. The Rod cannot be dropped, traded or destroyed, and does not appear in the inventory of the Pip-Boy 2000 Mark VI, due to being flagged as "non-playable." It comes with five different stats that affect fishing attempts, as followed.

| Stat | Affects | Default | Note | 
| Time To Hook | How fast a fish bites on the bopper. | Slow | Reduces the average delay before a fish bites. | 
| Line Strength | Escape speed of a hooked fish. | 100 | Higher: Fish escapes slower. Lower: Fish escapes faster. | 
| Reel In Speed | Reel in speed of a hooked fish. | 100 | Higher: Fish is reeled toward the player faster. Lower: Fish is reeled toward the player slower. | 
| Catch Zone | Size of catch zone that a hooked fish must be kept in. | 100 | Higher: Larger area, easier to keep fish in catch zone. Lower: Smaller area, harder to keep fish in catch zone. | 
| Rotation Speed | How fast the catch zone can be rotated. | 100 | Higher: Faster rotation, easier to keep fish in catch zone. Lower: Slower rotation, harder to keep fish in catch zone. | 

The Rod can only be modified, but not crafted. Added to the inventory during the fishing introduction quest Casting Off.
